prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion"]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Click and drag to move your pet around your desktop. Right-click anytime for quick controls, speech, or to hide the pet.", "Got It, Let's Go!", "Drag & drop to move | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk"]
2: ["Find Your Perfect Pet Match", "Answer two quick questions to get matched with your ideal pet companion."]
3: ["Desktop Setup Verification", "Confirm your pet is active and visible on your desktop before completing setup.", "Confirm & Finish Setup", "Pet rendered on screen | Sound enabled | Desktop overlay permission granted", "Test Pet Sound"]
4: ["Your pet customization and progress are permanently linked to your account.", "Cloud Save Protected"]
5: ["Did you know? You can train your pet custom tricks later!"]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate & Starter Gift", "Exclusive Starter Hat Unlocked!"]
7: ["Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pet", "Creating an account ensures your pet's memory, items, and settings are safe and recoverable anytime."]
8: ["Recommended for fast start: Select 'Quick Adopt' to get your desktop pet in under 60 seconds."]
9: ["Preparing pet animations..."]
